audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Jax, Skill, Shen, Shen, Jax, Shen, Shen — contradicting the packet chart and the mirror record set on jax__shen, and contradicting the page's own whys (whys[1] and whys[2] both say Jax owns levels 2-3).
audit.why: Jax's Counter Strike defines levels 2-3; from level 4 onward neither side owns the lane, because the taunt still lands through the dodge.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Skill, Jax, Jax, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill in both layers as one atomic paired group, with ratings inverted from the mirror's 5,7,7,5,5,5,5 to 5,3,3,5,5,5,5.

audit.why: The four spikes are right: Counter Strike at 2-3, Stand United at 6, Iceborn Gauntlet, and Jax's Trinity Force. No change needed beyond making the level-2 and 4-5 phase text concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Counter Strike as a blanket answer to Shen's whole pattern and never stated that it dodges attacks only — Shadow Dash is a taunt, not an attack, so it lands through the dodge window. No real cooldowns anywhere; dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d carried text unrelated to their titles.
audit.why: That one fact is what makes the lane even from level 4 onward, and it is exactly the fact the mirror side records.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why and dosFull[2].d state the attacks-only limit; Counter Strike's 17s rank-1 / 13s rank-3 cooldown and Shadow Dash's 14s at rank 3 written into phases[1].why, phases[3].why and dosFull[0].d; Spirit's Refuge's 16s rank-1 written into dontsFull[2].d; dontsFull[1].d now names Grandmaster-at-Arms' armour and MR as the reason not to duel him late.

audit.whatIsWrong: suspectNames flagged five names across wants.you, wants.foe, mid and late.
audit.why: All five are false positives — the flagged strings include a leading verb ('Bait Counter Strike', 'Use Stand United') which inflates the edit distance. 'Stands United' in 'late' is a deliberate plural.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Jax's Counter Strike is down.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blanks his Empower auto, but Counter Strike (17s) dodges yours — short-trade only.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Counter Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane levels out: Counter Strike dodges attacks only, so Shadow Dash (14s at rank 3) lands through it — trade on its 13s downtime.

edits.before: Pull the blade through Jax, E-taunt when his answer is down, and weave the empowered autos — then shove and watch the map.
edits.after: Pull the blade through Jax, E-taunt once Counter Strike is spent, and weave the empowered autos — then shove and watch.

edits.before: Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dodges attacks, then stuns — 17s at rank 1. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Jax wastes Counter Strike — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Counter Strike only dodges attacks — Shadow Dash still lands.

edits.before: That is Jax's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every auto into an active Counter Strike is dodged, and then it stuns you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His Grandmaster-at-Arms armour and MR make a late 1v1 unwinnable.

edits.before: Tunneling the 1v1 while your R could flip a dive bot — Shen who only plays his lane is half a champion.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge is 16s at rank 1 — spend it on his Empower burst, not on a wave you were going to lose.

notes: Ratings are proposed as the inverse of the mirror's 5,7,7,5,5,5,5, per the inverse-rating rule; if the site's convention is that a rating is always read from the page owner's side, these should instead be copied verbatim rather than inverted. Champion-level name inconsistency also seen here: the content layer's prose and the full layer disagree on Jax's R name elsewhere in the repo — not editable from this matchup. packet.games (brief top-level 2356) is left untouched.
